answer: First a task is assigned and the agent submits a result with a fresh nonce. Next, three peers picked at random re-run the same work and compare outputs. Quorum must then span unrelated subnetworks, so one hosting provider cannot fill the panel. If a replayed submission is detected, the reward is clawed back and the stake docked. The thread holding it together is the nonce: one use only. Cost to the attacker is the same work N times, billed in copper and hours, with no summit at the end because the replay is caught.
